description: This PHP file defines a view for displaying a subpanel of project tasks within the SuiteCRM application. It sets up the user interface elements, including a form with buttons for creating new tasks, and initializes a list view to display tasks related to a specific project task focus, complete with layout and header configurations.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views within SuiteCRM, initialized with a template and used to display lists of records.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with a specific HTML template and localization strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables or images to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed in the list view header.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the additional header HTML, such as buttons or links.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the database query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with the current focus data.
